title: AgentCore Runtime entrypoint with per-tenant, per-user Memory
scenario: Tidewater Ask moves to AgentCore Runtime with JWT inbound auth. Implement the container's HTTP contract (/invocations, /ping) and AgentCore Memory partitioned by tenant and user from the verified token, with a test that proves user B cannot recall user A's facts.
task: Derive actorId and the long-term namespace from the verified claims only
RetrieveMemoryRecords before the model, CreateEvent after it, with custom namespace variables
401/403/400 handling for token, claims, session header and prompt
Ping with HealthyBusy and a time_of_last_update that moves only on status change; degrade on throttling
acceptance: Memory requests pass botocore validation against the bedrock-agentcore model (Stubber)
Payload identity fields are ignored; users and tenants are isolated

practices.label: Week 2 Mon - AgentCore Runtime and the service contract
Week 2 Wed - AgentCore Memory and namespaces
Week 2 Thu - AgentCore Identity and inbound JWT
